title: Human-grounded Evaluations of Explanation Methods for Text Classification
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating explanation methods for AI models with the explicit goal of 'gaining trust from humans' and increasing 'humans' confidence and trust in the AI', which are key ethical considerations (transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness) in AI systems. The human-grounded evaluations assess how well these methods serve these purposes, thereby evaluating a component of AI ethics.
